brief: Paper and the fiche. The bulletin is only as new as the ferry.
epilogue: Two drafts, one sale. You write both numbers in the margin.

memos.subject: SPLIT DRAFTS
memos.text: Merchants have been observed dividing one sale into multiple drafts to stay under floor limit. This is fraud. Decline the second draft and report it.

rulebook.text: Decline any card number appearing in the current hot card bulletin.
Decline any charge that would put an account over its credit limit.
A charge at or under floor limit should not be called in. If it is, decline and note it.
Decline the second of two drafts from one merchant on one card within one shift (split draft).

calls.note: Same store, same card, 45 minutes later. The second draft is under the department floor. Callback confirms one sale split into two drafts.

items.head: MISSING
items.body: RCMP request assistance locating Gerald PUMPHREY, 52, last seen at his business October 22. He was not dressed for the weather. Anyone with information, please contact the detachment.

items.head: FISHERIES REPORT
